parameters.content:
## Daily executive digest v1

- Built-in schedule is the only scheduler: at 09:00 Europe/Moscow it calls the configured source workflow for the exact [start,end) window.
- Source adapter must return canonical Log Business Event records plus coverageStart/coverageEnd. Direct trigger is for test/manual batches.
- Missing source produces null/н/д; partial source exposes observed counts and warnings.
- LLM sees only window, coverage status and aggregates. Telegram and errors use shared workflows.
- Defaults are testMode and draftOnly; no credentials or personal examples are stored.
